S.FORM: alang Thgahan ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Banrong go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 49 buwan, 117 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 97% kyan ku 114 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 3% kyan ku 3 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Truku 59%, Amis 1%, Tayan 12%, Setik 14%, binah lihuyan s'uli 12%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ngasal psatu tegami ru pqniqan iyu. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Thgahan hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Thgahan hya' ga rgyax. tay mkyahu' na Thgahan hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Thgahan hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Thgahan hya' ga Maribasi. tay mkyahu' na Thgahan hya' ga Matanki. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Thgahan ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Thgahan ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ tħɣaħan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu βanroŋ ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa truku ** ami[s|ɕ] * tajan ** [s|ɕ]etik ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli ** maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ŋa[s|ɕ]al p[s|ɕ]atu teɣami ru pqniqan iju rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na tħɣaħan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na tħɣaħan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkjaħuʔ na tħɣaħan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na tħɣaħan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na tħɣaħan ħjaʔ ɣa mariβa[s|ɕ]i taj mkjaħuʔ na tħɣaħan ħjaʔ ɣa matanki reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ tħɣaħan ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ tħɣaħan ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
